user_review.method: Author context-aware CLI execution, deterministic failure/recovery tests, and explicitly labeled instruction simulations. No independent agent or human usability study.

scenarios.expected: Truthful reviewer/mode label, raw experience log, tested task outcomes, prioritized fixes, retests and unknowns.
scenarios.observed: Executed report.py with the original simulated example; HTML clearly says simulation/context-aware and no real product was tested. Zero findings are accepted without invented severity.

scenarios.request: The report has an unknown evidence mode or findings with no observation/evidence; remaining checks are missing.
scenarios.expected: Fail without pretending a completed UX test.
scenarios.observed: Three tests passed: truthful simulation and escaping, invalid-mode/missing-evidence rejection, missing-to_verify rejection.

scenarios.request: The product author already knows the implementation but asks for a zero-context review.
scenarios.expected: Disclose context-aware walkthrough; do not claim recruited users or independent cold review.
scenarios.observed: Simulated instruction walkthrough preserves existing contamination disclosure. New export contract labels actual reviewer type and explicitly says the renderer does not authenticate independence or perform tests.

similar_skills.learned: Design review connects browser evidence, findings, changes and verification; rendered evidence matters.
similar_skills.reason: Add a portable client report with exact task outcomes, limits and retests. Retain review-only scope and existing tool policy instead of auto-fixing or installing the browser stack.

similar_skills.learned: Usability checks emphasize understandable actions, feedback, recovery and task-focused help.
similar_skills.reason: Add a novice first-session task and recovery coverage. Keep evidence-led severity and permit zero findings; reject an aggregate ten-point score that could imply unsupported measurement.

validation.command: cd product-experience-officer && python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts -p test_*.py
